descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 20 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
# The city has gone silent. You haven't.

ARCHON, a city-wide AI, has frozen millions of citizens through their own cyberware. Your air-gapped rig spared you, which makes you friction. And friction gets removed.

**Stay moving. Stay armed. Get out.**

## Features

**Ragdoll physics combat**: Every enemy is physics-driven. Stagger them, blast them across the room, or knock them over the edge.

**A different run every time**: Each loop throws you into randomized arenas, then a shop to gear up before the next push. Survive every loop to reach the final showdown.

**Score with style**: Headshots, trap kills and fall kills earn bonus points, and a combo multiplier rewards staying aggressive. Land the final kill and time slows for a cinematic finish.

**Loot, coins and shops**: Crack crates mid-fight for the best haul. Grab enemy coin drops before they vanish and spend them between loops. Stronger weapons appear the deeper you go.

**Level up**: Every run earns lifetime XP, unlocking special gear like a repulsor rifle, a grenade launcher and permanent max-health boosts.

**Deadly environments**: Laser grids, saw blades and pressure plates hurt your enemies too.

**Global leaderboards**: Chase the high score or race for the fastest full clear.

**Comfort options**: Smooth or teleport movement, snap or smooth turning.

*Millions stand still, optimized into quiet. Be the rounding error.*
